subject: Post-demo consumption ladder + budget alignment
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@clearmind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo consumption ladder + budget alignment

Thanks again for a great demo this morning, Alex — appreciate the candor on expected patterns. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we’re all aligned: 

- High level profile you shared:
  - Typical monthly tokens (in steady state): ~12M tokens/month
  - Anticipated 99th percentile concurrency peak: ~220 TPS for short windows (2–10m)
  - Burst behavior: spikes up to ~400 TPS for <5 minutes during peak events
  - Target unit economics: looking for ~$650–750 per 1M tokens (budget needs sign-off)

- Immediate asks from us (next 48–72 hours):
  1) Confirm whether 12M/month is monthly active (avg) or total across all services — helps pricing slab design
  2) Clarify procurement timeline (PO / legal window) — you mentioned end of July as target
  3) Any hard constraints on burst handling vs sustained reserved capacity?

What we’ll provide by tomorrow:
- A simple hosted pricing matrix tailored to your 12M profile with a pricing ladder and burst credit proposal (attached: proposal-draft.pdf stub)
- Notes on how we guarantee the 99th percentile TPS and what capacity reservation would look like for the 220 TPS target

Proposed immediate next step: 30-minute walk-through of the pricing ladder + SLA tradeoffs. Are you available Thurs 6/19 at 10am PT?

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: proposal-draft.pdf (1 page — hosted pricing matrix sketch)
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@clearmind.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo consumption ladder + budget alignment

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 12M tokens is our approximate total monthly consumption across 3 features (chat assistant, summarization, and a lightweight reranker). We expect a steady baseline ~9–10M and episodic bursts that bring it up to ~12M for campaign periods. 
- Peak is correct as you noted: 99th around 220 TPS, but very short-lived — most spikes are 3–7 minutes. We can tolerate throttling on lower-priority requests during spikes but would like to avoid dropping user-facing assistant requests.
- Budget: our procurement team has signaled an internal target of $700 / 1M tokens (they asked if there’s flexibility with a short-term pilot discount).
- Procurement window: ideally wrapped by end of July but pilot can start sooner.

Happy to do the 6/19 10am PT call — confirmed. One more ask: can you include an example monthly bill calc for the 12M baseline + 25% surge allowance so our finance folks can see the run-rate?

–Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Platform Product — ClearMind.ai
alex.moreno@clearmind.ai | +1 (650) 555-0122

Subject: Fwd: Post-demo consumption ladder + budget alignment (ClearMind)

Looping you both in — Alex confirmed 12M tokens/month (9–10M baseline + episodic bursts to 12M) and their finance target is $700 / 1M with pilot discount ask. Procurement end-of-July.

Quick internal notes / ask: 
- Pricing approach idea: tiered hosted rates so we protect unit economics but give ClearMind a path to $700 with commitment. Example sketch: $750 /1M for first 10M, $650 /1M for next tranche. That nets ~ (10M*$750 + 2M*$650)/12M = blended ~$731/1M -> meets their ask if we offer pilot credits to bring effective $/1M to $700 for first 3 months.
- Capacity: baseline reservation to cover 220 TPS 99th with an autoscale-burst buffer to handle 400 TPS spikes. Recommend we size dedicated capacity equivalent for predictable latency (or guarantee a hosted SLA at 220 TPS with burst credits).
- Ops ask: need an example monthly invoice showing baseline (12M) + 25% surge allowance per Alex’s request for finance.

Ben — can you produce a short pricing-matrix.csv that shows the slab math and a pilot-credit line (3 months) before today’s call? Marissa — I’ll want your opinion on SLA language for the hosted option (99th @ 220 TPS with burst credits).

Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@clearmind.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 14:20:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo consumption ladder + budget alignment

Alex — thanks for the clarity and the timeline. Attached is a compact pricing matrix (pricing-matrix.csv stub) and a quick example invoice for the sample profile you described. Key points up front: 

- Proposed hosted pricing (option A - tiered):
  - 0–10M tokens/month: $750 / 1M tokens
  - 10–50M tokens/month: $650 / 1M tokens
  - Effective blended price at 12M (no pilot credits): ~$731 / 1M tokens => estimated monthly bill: ~$8,772

- Pilot incentive: 3 months of a $30 / 1M credit applied to first 12M monthly consumption -> effective $701 / 1M for months 1–3, then reverts to tiered pricing. We can discuss a slightly deeper one-off discount if ClearMind is willing to sign a 12-month committed band.

- Capacity / SLA: We can guarantee 99th percentile latency targets at 220 TPS with a burst pool for up to 400 TPS for short windows. If you want sustained bursts above 250 TPS we’d recommend a short reserved uplift or a temporary burst pool add-on (pricing in the attached).

Next steps:
1) Quick pricing walkthrough on today’s 10am PT call (confirming the calendar invite).
2) I’ll send over a clean SOW + pilot terms after the call.
3) If procurement wants numbers for finance, use the attached example invoice (shows baseline + 25% surge allowance) and I can introduce our finance lead to theirs.

If that works I’ll also include a simple line-item explaining how token counting is measured (input vs. output tokens, rounding, and truncation behavior) so there are no surprises.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
